meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (PRC statutory system); Taiwan maintains a separate civil-law commercial system, with cross-strait agreements governing investment, tax, and documentary authentication

Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, 2012
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation on Income and Prevention of Tax Evasion, 2015

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (Order No. 3 of the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation, effective 1 November 2024); Provisions for the Administration of Customer Due Diligence and Identification in Financial Institutions (PBOC, as amended); Counter-Terrorism Law of the PRC; Criminal Law of the PRC provisions on money-laundering predicate offenses.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Company Registration Record of the Taiwan investor)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: Not available because Taiwan is not a party to the Apostille Convention and the PRC accession does not apply to cross-strait documents. Consular Legalization: Not available because no consular relations exist between the PRC and Taiwan. Mandatory path: Taiwan public notary notarization, then SEF verification at the Straits Exchange Foundation, then ARATS verification at the local provincial office of the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits in the PRC, followed by certified Simplified Chinese translation. Do not add Apostille or consular legalization after this cross-strait path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Company Registration History / Suspension and Commencement Record)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: Not available. Consular Legalization: Not available. Mandatory path: Taiwan public notary notarization, then SEF verification, then ARATS verification at the PRC provincial office, then certified Chinese translation. This is the exclusive authentication sequence; do not chain Apostille or consular steps.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwan investor, with Taiwan public notary attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: Not available. Consular Legalization: Not available. Mandatory path: Board resolution executed by the Taiwan parent, notarized by a Taiwan public notary, verified by SEF, verified by ARATS at the PRC provincial office, then translated into Simplified Chinese. No Apostille or consular legalization may be appended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Charter of the Taiwan investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: Not available. Consular Legalization: Not available. Mandatory path: Certified copy from MOEA Taiwan, notarized by Taiwan public notary, verified by SEF, verified by ARATS at the PRC provincial office, then translated. The cross-strait verification route replaces and excludes the Apostille and consular routes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwan investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualifying Taiwan commercial bank / financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: Not available. Consular Legalization: Not available. Mandatory path: Bank officer countersignature and seal notarized by Taiwan public notary, then SEF verification, then ARATS verification at the PRC provincial office, then certified Chinese translation. Do not combine this path with Apostille or consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before closing, every Taiwan parent entity, each UBO holding 25% or more, each director, supervisor, and authorized signatory must be screened against the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring List, the PBOC sanctions gazettes, China's Unreliable Entity List, China's Export Control Entity List, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC's SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the UK OFSI Consolidated List. PEP classification must cover mainland Chinese and Taiwan senior political figures, family members, and close associates, with mandatory senior management approval for any PEP. Enhanced due diligence must verify the entire beneficial-ownership chain, require negative news screening in Chinese and English, review Taiwan corporate registry history, and screen all Swift_LC and TT_Wire counterparties for sanctions nexus. Results must be refreshed every 90 days and on any change in ownership until registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and the SAMR Online Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration System (operated by the provincial Administration for Market Regulation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE registered name must be in simplified Chinese characters. The statutory four-tier naming formula is: Administrative Division + Distinctive Trade Name + Industry/Operating Characteristics + Legal Form (Limited Company). An English name may be registered as an auxiliary name but must be transliterated from the Chinese trade name using standard mainland pinyin; Taiwan romanization systems such as Wade-Giles are not accepted. All cross-strait verified

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 128-135 (incorporation), 154 (limited liability), 370-386 (foreign investment companies); Foreign Investment Act (外國人投資條例); Medical Devices Act (醫療器材管理法) Arts. 29-32; Factory Management Act (工廠管理輔導法)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部商業發展署)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Application Form and Articles of Incorporation (公司章程暨設立登記申請書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum under Company Act Art. 100 II (capital floor abolished 2009); capital must be adequate for the endoscope manufacturing operation, remitted from abroad into a Taiwan New Dollar bank account, and certified by a licensed CPA via capital verification report before MOEA registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST: The founding shareholder's subscription of all registered capital shares in the Company is ratified and accepted, and the duly remitted paid-up capital shall be held in a segregated bank account in Taiwan for statutory verification. RESOLVED SECOND: The registered office of the Company is fixed at [address], Taipei, Taiwan, being the place for service of process. RESOLVED THIRD: [Name] is appointed Director and Chairperson, [Name] General Manager, and [Name] Statutory Representative, each to serve until the first annual shareholders' meeting. RESOLVED FOURTH: Banking signatories, company seal, and escrow authorization are approved. RESOLVED FIFTH: Officers are authorized to execute incorporation applications, foreign investment approval filings, and all TFDA, industrial, environmental, and fire safety licensing documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議委員會), online portal investtaiwan.org.tw
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Foreign Investment Application with an investment plan, identity documents, and audited financials of the overseas investing shareholder. Obtain the approval letter permitting incorporation with the proposed registered capital and business scope; approval is a strict precondition to remitting capital and filing company registration.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form (投資申請書)
Certificate of incorporation/registration of the foreign investor
Audited financial statements of the foreign investor for the last fiscal year
Investment plan covering production, staffing, and premises
Legalized power of attorney and agent identification
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Bank intent letter for capital remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, respond within the prescribed supplementation period (generally 30 days) through the same portal; a denial may be administratively appealed to the Executive Yuan within 30 days of the written decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Approval and Registration Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, MOEA (經濟部商業發展署) via the Company One-Stop Service (一站式線上申請)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the name pre-approval (公司名稱預查), then submit the incorporation application with Articles, incorporation meeting minutes, CPA capital verification, and proof of the registered office. Pay electronic fees; the authority issues the Company Registration Certificate with the Unified Business Number.
required_dossiers: Company name and scope pre-approval form
Articles of Incorporation signed by all shareholders
Incorporator meeting minutes (發起人會議紀錄)
CPA capital verification report (資本額查核報告書)
Bank certificate of the paid-up capital account
Registered office proof (lease or title deed with landlord consent)
Director and chairperson consent forms
Identification documents of shareholders and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify and resubmit within 15 days of a correction notice; refusal is appealable within 30 days under Company Act Art. 387 and the Administrative Appeal Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (財政部各地區國稅局), local branch by registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days of company registration, file the business registration (營業登記) to obtain the tax registration number, VAT taxpayer status, and unified invoice authorization; apply for the Taxpayer Necessity Certificate and arrange electronic invoicing.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate (公司登記證明書)
Articles of Incorporation
Lease agreement with land/building owner consent
Company seal and representative identification
Business registration application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Provide supplementary documents on demand; any assessment may be appealed to the taxation bureau within 30 days under the Tax Collection Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: TFDA Medical Device Manufacturer License and Quality System Audit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare (衛生福利部食品藥物管理署)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the manufacturing site on the TFDA e-platform, submit quality system and product technical documentation, and undergo the on-site Medical Device Quality Management System (MD-QMS) audit covering design controls, cleanroom/sterility assurance, and production. Obtain the Medical Device Manufacturing License (醫療器材製造許可證) before commercial production.
required_dossiers: Medical device manufacturer license application (醫療器材製造業者許可申請書)
QMS quality manual and standard operating procedures
Facility layout and cleanroom certification (ISO Class 7/8)
Product technical file for the 4K rigid endoscope tower (ISO 13485 / IEC 60601-2-18)
Manufacturing equipment list with calibration certificates
Personnel qualification records of the QA manager and authorized representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit a corrective action plan if audit deficiencies are identified and undergo a re-audit at the next available slot (generally within 6 months); license refusal may be administratively appealed to the Ministry of Health and Welfare.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Administration, MOEA (經濟部產業發展署) via the local municipal government industrial affairs department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After building and land-use compliance is confirmed, submit the factory registration application with layout, fire safety, and environmental documents. The local agency conducts an on-site inspection of production facilities, confirms the manufacturing scope, and issues the Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證).
required_dossiers: Factory registration application form (工廠登記申請書)
Company registration certificate
Building usage permit (使用執照) and lease
Urban planning or non-urban land use compliance certificate
Industrial waste discharge plan or treatment contract
Fire safety inspection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Supplement deficiencies within 30 days of notice; rejected applications may be resubmitted after compliance, with administrative appeal available within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Environment (環境部) and the local environmental protection bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the enterprise pollution regulation registration, including wastewater discharge, air emission, and waste handling inventories. Obtain a wastewater discharge permit where daily flow exceeds regulatory thresholds, register the medical waste tracking manifest, and execute an incineration contract with a licensed treater.
required_dossiers: Pollution regulation registration form (污染列管申報)
Process flow chart and environmental screening self-assessment (自評表)
Wastewater discharge permit application with effluent sampling data
Air pollutant and VOC emission inventory
Medical waste disposal contract with manifest registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Complete missing sampling or documentation; matters spanning water, air, and waste bureaus undergo joint review; permit denial is appealable under the Administrative Appeal Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Safety, Structural, and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Fire Department (消防局) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration, MOL (勞動部職業安全衛生署)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Commission a licensed architect or structural engineer to certify the building load capacity for cleanroom and equipment floors; request fire safety equipment inspection; file the occupational safety plan and workplace risk assessment; complete self-inspection of machinery and emergency evacuation procedures.
required_dossiers: Fire safety installation inspection report (消防安全設備檢修申報)
Structure and fireproofing certification by a registered architect
Occupational safety and health management plan with risk assessment
Emergency evacuation plan and fire extinguishing system proof
Factory registration certificate copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify fire safety deficiencies within the issued deadline and schedule re-inspection; occupational non-compliance triggers correction orders under the Occupational Safety and Health Act Arts. 6-7, with site closure only in cases of imminent danger.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部產業發展署) jointly with Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Devices Manufacturing License (醫療器材製造許可證) under the Medical Devices Act (醫療器材管理法) Art. 29, and Factory Registration Certificate (工廠登記證) under the Factory Management Act (工廠管理輔導法)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (環境部), Environmental Protection Administration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Registration / Self-Declaration: the surgical endoscope assembly and cleanroom facility is not on the mandatory EIA list under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act Art. 5 and Annex II, unless wastewater discharge equals or exceeds 100 CMD, which would trigger a full EIA report review by the Environmental Impact Assessment Review Committee.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent per Effluent Standards (放流水標準): pH 6.0-9.0, COD ≤ 100 mg/L, SS ≤ 30 mg/L, temperature ≤ 38°C. Stationary-source VOC emissions per the Clean Air Act and emission standards, with annual mass-balance reporting if VOC usage exceeds 20 t/y. Medical waste per the Waste Disposal Act, classified as infectious medical waste and incinerated by a licensed treater at ≥ 850°C.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety equipment inspection and certificate under Fire Services Act Art. 10; building usage permit with structural load certification for cleanroom and equipment floors; occupational safety and health clearance and emergency response plan per the Occupational Safety and Health Act; workplace self-inspection covering exhaust, electrical, and machine guarding systems.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, administered through provincial and municipal tax services; taxpayer portal: China Electronic Tax Bureau (etax.chinatax.gov.cn); trade facilitation and customs clearance portal: China International Trade Single Window (singlewindow.cn); foreign exchange monitoring: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through designated commercial banks.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) as a Chinese limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the business licence carrying the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which by operation of law constitutes the statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN), the VAT registration number, and the Customs enterprise code base. Step 2: Complete supplementary tax registration particulars (legal representative, registered address, accounting system and standards, bank settlement accounts, tax handling officer) through the Electronic Tax Bureau portal within 30 days of business licence issuance. Step 3: Elect general VAT taxpayer status; this election is mandatory where the projected annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000 and is commercially necessary for any exporter because small-scale status forfeits input VAT credits and export refunds. Step 4: Enrol in the national fully digitalised electronic invoice (EDI) platform and obtain electronic invoice issuance quotas for both ordinary VAT invoices and special VAT invoices. Step 5: Register with Customs for declaration purposes, obtain the Customs enterprise registration number, file for export tax rebate qualification under the manufacturer exemption-credit-refund method, and complete SAFE foreign-exchange registration for the export proceeds collection account. Step 6: Open designated RMB and foreign-currency settlement accounts, execute the tax filing calendar (monthly VAT and quarterly CIT provisional filings, annual CIT settlement, non-resident withholding registration), and appoint a responsible tax accountant; all registration steps are executable through the integrated electronic platform without physical attendance at the tax service hall.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the WFOE is a Chinese tax-resident limited liability enterprise taxed on worldwide income at the 25% headline Corporate Income Tax (CIT) rate. China does not recognise pass-through or partnership tax treatment for a foreign-invested limited liability company, and no fiscal transparency election exists. The WFOE is simultaneously a VAT taxpayer, an urban maintenance and construction tax payer, a stamp duty taxpayer, and a statutory withholding agent for non-resident dividends, interest, royalties, rents, and service fees. Distributions of after-tax profits to the ultimate foreign shareholder are in principle subject to 10% dividend withholding tax, reducible to 5% where the beneficial owner is a tax-treaty resident (including the position under the Cross-Strait Tax Cooperation Agreement where the Taiwan shareholder holds at least 25% capital and meets substance conditions).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China maintains no check-the-box, pass-through, or OECD-style hybrid-mismatch elective regime; hybrid arrangements are neutralised mechanically under the categorical anti-deferral and deductibility rules contained in Caishui [2019] No. 88 and the associated announcements. The elections that are legally available to the WFOE: (i) VAT taxpayer status election: general taxpayer (input-VAT crediting, 13%/9%/6% rates) versus small-scale taxpayer (3% simplified levy, reduced to 1% in the 2023-2027 preferential window), the former being mandatory above RMB 5,000,000 annual turnover; (ii) export rebate method election: manufacturers self-producing exported goods apply the exemption-credit-refund mechanism, while trading intermediaries use the exemption-refund mechanism; (iii) transfer pricing method election among the five OECD-aligned pricing methods (comparable uncontrolled price, resale price, cost-plus, transactional net margin, profit split), including the option to petition for a unilateral Advance Pricing Agreement; (iv) foreign tax credit election: direct credit per-country limitation, with an indirect credit election for dividends received from qualifying lower-tier foreign subsidiaries; (v) fixed-asset depreciation method election, including accelerated depreciation for qualifying equipment specified in the CIT implementing regulations; (vi) CIT loss carryforward utilisation election: 5-year general carryforward, extended to 10 years for qualifying high-technology enterprises (including certain advanced medical device manufacturers); (vii) no group registration, fiscal unity, or consolidated CIT filing is available; the WFOE must file on a standalone legal-entity basis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT Law (effective 1 January 2026) read with the former Provisional VAT Regulations and the State Taxation Administration implementing rules, administered through the Golden Tax Phase IV real-time tax-control and data-matching system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 of annual taxable turnover in the preceding 12 consecutive months is the statutory threshold above which registration as a general VAT taxpayer is mandatory. Below this threshold, the enterprise may elect small-scale taxpayer status (simplified 3% levy rate; reduced to 1% for small-scale taxpayers during the 2023-2027 preferential window), but any export-oriented WFOE should elect general taxpayer status to preserve input VAT credits and export refunds. VAT registration as such is compulsory for every enterprise upon incorporation regardless of turnover; a WFOE can never operate outside the VAT net. Additional de minimis exemptions apply to micro businesses with monthly turnover of RMB 100,000 or less, but these exemptions do not eliminate the registration duty.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a mandatory fully digitalised electronic invoice regime: all VAT invoices, both ordinary and special, must be generated through the STA's national e-invoice service platform and transmitted in real time to the Golden Tax Phase IV databases. Every invoice carries a machine-verified digital stamp, a unique nationwide invoice code, and a two-dimensional tax-control mark. A special VAT invoice is a strict precondition for claiming any input VAT credit and must be verified and matched online before the credit is allowed. No private third-party fiscalisation intermediary or physical stamping exists; the government platform performs real-time validation and release at the moment of issuance. For exports, the China International Trade Single Window interconnects the customs export declaration, the export sales invoice, the transport document (bill of lading or waybill), and the bank's foreign-exchange receipt data, creating a compulsory four-agency reconciliation chain (Customs, Tax, Bank, Logistics). Post-issuance invoice cancellation or red-flag corrections are systematically audited and may trigger automatic blockage of the exporter's rebate quota.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may claim the 0% export VAT rate, coupled with the refund or offset of creditable input VAT under the exemption-credit-refund method, for self-manufactured medical devices, including ultra-high-definition 4K minimally invasive rigid endoscope towers classifiable under ISIC 3250 / HS heading 9018. The conditions that must coexist are: (i) the goods physically leave the PRC customs territory, including a supply to Taiwan, which is treated de facto as a separate customs territory in cross-strait trade, or to any other foreign destination; (ii) the WFOE has elected and holds general VAT taxpayer status and possesses a valid Customs enterprise registration code; (iii) the export proceeds are collected in convertible foreign currency (or in RMB under approved cross-border settlement channels) and are repatriated through a designated bank within the statutory 180-day period; (iv) the data sets contained in the Customs export declaration, the sales invoices, the logistics documents, and the bank receipts are materially consistent and truthful; (v) the WFOE has not committed export-rebate fraud, smuggling, or a serious tax or customs infringement in the preceding 36 months; (vi) the complete substantiation docket is retained for at least 5 years from the export date, being the applicable audit-claim period. Cross-border services associated with the laparoscopy-tower supplies (commissioning, installation, operator training, and embedded software) qualify for zero-rating only as offshore services where the service is physically rendered from the PRC for consumption entirely in Taiwan or another foreign jurisdiction, supported by the overseas contract, performance evidence, and foreign-currency receipt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口货物报关单) lodged electronically through the China International Trade Single Window, bearing the customs release number and the actual date of export
Commercial Invoice and Export Packing List identifying the buyer, HS classification, quantity, unit price, and Incoterms of the laparoscopy-tower equipment
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, being the original negotiable transport document evidencing physical departure of the goods from a PRC port or airport

Inward Remittance Certificate (出口收汇银行入账凭证/涉外收入申报单) issued by the designated foreign-exchange bank confirming receipt of export proceeds in convertible currency from the Taiwan buyer or other overseas customer
Export Sales Contract together with payment-rail evidence such as Letter of Credit, SWIFT MT103, or MT700 wire instruction

Special VAT invoices for purchased materials, components, energy, production consumables, and manufacturing overheads used in producing the exported goods, with the corresponding online VAT invoice verification records
Medical device export record-filing certificate and any statutory manufacturing or export licence issued by the national medical products administration for the rigid endoscope and laparoscopy tower
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The export-rebate system is enforced through compulsory four-agency data reconciliation whereby the Customs export declaration, the VAT sales invoice, the bank foreign-exchange receipt, and the logistics movement record are matched algorithmically; any discrepancy triggers an automatic risk-control investigation before the rebate is disbursed. The applicable penalties are: (i) clawback of the entire VAT refund together with late-payment surcharge accruing at 0.05% per day from the refund payment date; (ii) administrative penalty of 50% up to 500% (fivefold) of the fraudulently obtained refund amount under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection; (iii) denial or suspension of export-rebate qualification for up to 3 years, downgrade of the enterprise tax credit rating, and institution of restricted invoice issuance quotas; (iv) separate Customs Law penalties for false declarations, under-declaration, or smuggling of medical devices, including confiscation of goods and fines of up to 3 times the dutiable value; (v) criminal liability under the Criminal Law for fraudulent export refund, carrying fines plus imprisonment from less than 3 years up to life imprisonment where the defrauded amount reaches RMB 5 million or more or the circumstances are especially serious, together with mandatory confiscation of property; (vi) SAFE administrative fines between 5% and 30% of the unrepatriated amount where the 180-day export-proceeds collection deadline is missed without an approved extension; (vii) personal joint and several liability and personal travel bans imposed on the legal representative and the responsible finance officer where wilful fraud is established in enforcement proceedings.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Under the PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (1996, as amended), RMB is convertible for current account transactions, including goods trade, services trade, investment income (dividends), royalties, and current-account expenses, provided that the underlying transaction is genuine, lawful, and supported by documentary evidence. Capital account transactions remain subject to a registration or approval system: inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) into the capital account requires a SAFE FDI registration and bank-level verification; the paid-in capital is routed through an approved foreign exchange capital account and may be settled into RMB only in accordance with SAFE's capital account settlement rules. Profit remittance by the WFOE to the Taiwan parent is classified as investment income on the current account and is permitted after the board of directors has declared dividends, the distributable profit is verified by a Chinese certified public accountant, the required tax payment or tax exemption certificate has been issued, and the settlement bank has received the audit report, dividend resolution, and supporting tax documents. Key remittance hurdles include the possibility that accumulated losses restrict distributable profits, the requirement to pay withholding income tax at a rate generally around 10% absent an applicable arrangement to reduce it, and the need to ensure bank compliance with PBOC's financial account reporting (FATCA/CRS) obligations. Capital injections, by contrast, cannot be remitted as ordinary trade payments; they must follow the specific inbound FDI wire-purpose-code routing and be verified against the SAFE registration code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory mandatory surrender ratio is nil. Since 2012, China has abolished mandatory conversion of export proceeds; a WFOE may freely retain export receipts in a foreign-currency settlement account or settle them into RMB through a licensed bank, subject to genuineness and trade-verification review. The repatriation requirement, however, requires that export proceeds for goods declared by the WFOE be brought into China and deposited in a domestic foreign-exchange account. Under the SAFE Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Administration Measures (Huifa [2012] No. 38, as amended), export proceeds should generally be collected within 90 days from the date of the export customs declaration; if collection occurs more than 90 days after export, the enterprise must register the delayed collection in the foreign exchange monitoring system through the bank. Failure to comply may generate an abnormal trade-inspection record and downgrade the enterprise's A/B/C administrative classification, which in turn increases the documentation burden for all subsequent cross-border transactions. No forced percentage conversion applies to the export receipts of ordinary manufacturing enterprises.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium as a secondary collection channel, and not acceptable as the primary treasury rail. Under PRC law, only licensed banks and licensed payment institutions are permitted to conduct cross-border RMB or foreign-currency clearing; offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Payoneer, and Currenxie are not licensed to serve as the collecting bank for PRC export proceeds. The WFOE's export proceeds arising from goods customs-declared in China must be repatriated through a domestic foreign-exchange settlement account at a licensed bank. Receiving funds into an offshore EMI account and then transferring them into the PRC may violate the SAFE repatriation requirement and expose the WFOE to anti-structuring and AML scrutiny. EMIs may be used for ancillary transactions, such as inbound payments for pre-sale R&D or service fees, but only if the underlying transaction is current-account compliant, the funds are remitted in accordance with the purpose code, and the bank can see the full documentary trail. A formal Legal-Compliance assessment must be completed before any offshore EMI is used for actual treasury receipts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for opening a corporate RMB basic deposit account and for opening a foreign exchange capital account at an onshore bank. Fully remote account opening is not permitted for legal-person accounts under PBOC account rules and anti-money laundering requirements. The WFOE's legal representative, or an authorized senior officer (e.g., CFO/General Manager) with a board resolution, power of attorney, and company seal, must appear in person at the bank branch for a face-to-face KYC interview. For a WFOE with foreign directors, the beneficial owner may participate via video conference for additional verification, but an authorized physical signatory in China must still complete the on-site interview and seal application. Taiwan-issued power of attorney and corporate documentary evidence must be notarized by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) and authenticated by the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) before mainland banks will accept them.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated WFOE with no operating history but a large injection of registered capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified business licence and unified social credit code; notarized articles of association; source-of-funds certificate from the Taiwan shareholder; audited projection; board resolution approving the capital injection; underlying probe/term-sheet from banking counsel; complete UBO declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or Taiwanese parent using Hong Kong/Samoa holding vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full legal entity organigram showing all intermediates and ultimate beneficial owners; certified BO declarations; certificate of good standing of holding vehicles; economic-substance documentation; legal opinion on non-sanctions exposure and legitimacy of corporate chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intercompany trade flows with the Taiwan parent showing customs-value mismatches or non-arm's-length pricing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed intercompany sales and procurement contracts; invoices; packing lists; bills of lading; customs declarations; foreign-exchange trade verification reports; transfer pricing documentation or benchmark study; intercompany settlement methodology policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value transactions for surgical/laparoscopy towers without clear regulatory permits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: NMPA (China) medical device registration permit; ISO 13485 certificate; CE marking where applicable; US FDA establishment registration and device listing; local export control certifications; import permit of destination market; tariff classification evidence (HS codes).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or restricted-party flags in the counterparty or payment routing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time screening against OFAC, EU, UN, and mainland China consolidated lists; attestation of trade compliance; end-user certificates; supply-chain origin declarations; negative press / adverse media search summary; bank-sanctioned compliance attestation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan parent's capital injection must be remitted to the WFOE's approved 'FDI Capital Escrow Account' (Foreign Exchange Capital Account) at a domestic designated bank. Prior to remittance, the WFOE must complete the SAFE FDI registration with the bank and obtain the FDI registration number tied to the unified social credit code. The inbound wire (SWIFT MT103) should state the purpose as 'FDI Capital Injection / Paid-in Capital' in field 70 and include the FDI registration number, the company name, and the account number in the beneficiary bank instruction. The remitting bank in Taiwan may need a correspondent bank for USD/HKD/TWD routing; settlement into RMB is permitted only after the receiving bank verifies the capital account against SAFE systems. Verification files include the completed FDI registration form, the business licence, the foreign investor's passport/corporate documents, the board and shareholder resolution approving the injection, and a notarized capital contribution schedule. The capital account balance cannot be used for purposes unrelated to the approved business scope, nor can it be applied to pay off intercompany loans without SAFE permission.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The WFOE will use standard documentary trade and treasury rails for outbound disbursements: (i) irrevocable commercial letters of credit (LC) opened by the WFOE's domestic bank for large or medium-high value import/procurement transactions, with the Taiwan supplier as beneficiary; (ii) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for open-account payments for suppliers and service providers, subject to SAFE's genuine-transaction verification and trade monitoring; (iii) documentary collections (D/P and D/A) for repetitive, low-risk trade partners; (iv) Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) RMB clearing for settlements permitted in CNY between mainland China and Taiwan corporate counterparties; and (v) for dividend and royalty remittances to the Taiwan parent, bank-settled MT103 wires with the tax withholding certificate, audited financial statements, and board dividend resolution attached. All outbound trade payments must be matched to an underlying contract, invoice, customs declaration (where goods cross borders), and the relevant SAFE 'trade verification' entry; payment instruction fields must include the transaction purpose code and supporting reference numbers, or the bank will suspend the transfer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/CNY foreign exchange forward contracts (current-account and trade-based hedging) with a licensed domestic bank
Onshore USD/CNY foreign exchange swaps (cash/forward combinations) for short-term liquidity and trade cash-flow equalization
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for medium and long-term USD/CNY hedging related to the top-up equity loan or business cash-flow matching
Foreign exchange option and option-combination products for eligible enterprise treasury clients with a declared hedging objective and risk-management capacity

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for the onshore WFOE; they may be used only by the offshore Taiwan parent on the ultimate economic exposure and must remain outside the WFOE's domestic regulatory perimeter

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May to 31 May following the fiscal year-end; extension may apply where legally approved
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger a surcharge of 10% of tax payable, subject to statutory minimum and maximum amounts; non-filing may trigger additional tax assessment and penalties. No routine automatic strike-off applies solely for tax lateness.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and business report approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting; Ministry of Economic Affairs registry only where a registrable change results
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual shareholders' meeting generally within six months after the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene or approve required annual matters may result in Company Act penalties, director liability, and administrative orders. Persistent statutory non-compliance may support dissolution or revocation proceedings under applicable law.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-invested enterprise annual operating or investment-status reporting, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, or its designated reporting platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Deadline depends on the applicable foreign-investment approval, reporting notice, and enterprise classification; verify annually with the competent authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate reporting may result in corrective orders, administrative fines, and restrictions on future investment or capital remittance procedures. Automatic annual strike-off is not the standard sanction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local competent authority under the Ministry of Economic Affairs company registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within 15 days after a registrable change, including changes to directors, capital, business scope, address, or representative
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines commonly range from approximately NT$10,000 to NT$50,000, with continuing fines possible until correction. Material or persistent non-compliance may lead to dissolution or revocation action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual regulatory and tax review of medical-device manufacturing licence status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration and relevant local health authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Maintain continuously; renew or update before the licence-specific expiry date and report material changes within the prescribed period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a valid licence or failing to report required changes may result in corrective orders, fines, suspension, product restrictions, or licence cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not generally applicable to a private Taiwan company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No universal annual return or annual franchise filing applies; confirm whether a sector-specific or foreign-investment report is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No sanction applies where no annual return is legally required. Late filing of a separate required report remains subject to the applicable administrative penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit and certification are generally required for public companies and private companies meeting applicable statutory thresholds, including the paid-in-capital threshold commonly set at NT$30 million, or other prescribed size, revenue, employee, industry, or regulatory criteria. A foreign-owned manufacturing company may also be subject to audit under investment, tax, financing, or regulatory requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS applies to entities within the mandatory IFRS categories; other companies generally use Taiwan Enterprise Accounting Standards or applicable Taiwan GAAP. Tax computations must comply with Taiwan tax accounting rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not generally require a standalone annual UBO confirmation for every private company. The company should maintain current beneficial-owner and control information, update it when ownership or control changes, update the shareholder register for share transfers, and provide information to competent authorities or regulated financial institutions when required. Registrable corporate changes generally require filing within the applicable statutory period.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Supervisors, where applicable
Minute Book of shareholders' meetings and board meetings
Accounting books and supporting accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 800-3,000 per year for registered-office, company-secretarial, local filing, and compliance support services; no universal annual registered-agent renewal fee applies.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 3,000-15,000 per year for a private foreign-owned manufacturing company, depending on revenue, inventory, transactions, internal controls, licence requirements, and whether a statutory CPA audit is mandatory.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential 15% rate for High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE) certified under PRC administrative rules; effective 5%–10% reduced rates for Small Low-Profit Enterprises (SLPE) under tiered taxable income caps (≤ RMB 3 million in 2024); 100% additional super-deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; 20% investment tax credit for qualifying venture capital investments; tax exemption on qualifying technology transfer income up to RMB 5 million.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A200000 (Enterprise Income Tax Annual Filing Return) with mandatory Schedules A100000, A105000 and related schedules; filed electronically through the China Electronic Tax Administration Portal (e-Tax, 电子税务局).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement and quarterly advance prepayments (Form A200002) due within 15 calendar days after each quarter-end; final annual return due by May 31 of the following calendar year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return and full payment must be submitted by 31 May of the calendar year immediately following the tax year (fiscal year = calendar year unless separately approved).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating income (营业收入): gross sales of ultra-high-definition 4K surgical laparoscopy towers, spare parts, service fees, and other manufacturing-related revenues.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Chinese-resident WFOE, report all global revenue. For a non-resident with a permanent establishment, enter only China-source revenue attributable to that PE; do not include offshore procurement flows.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs (营业成本): direct materials, direct labour, manufacturing overhead, and cost of finished medical devices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must reconcile with statutory books and transfer pricing documentation. Non-resident claims must allocate costs under the arm's length principle and avoid duplicate deduction in Taiwan.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses (营业费用): selling, general, administrative, and R&D expenses; excludes interest and foreign exchange losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only if directly incurred in generating China-source taxable income; management fees from the Taiwan parent require supporting service agreements and must satisfy beneficial use test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit (利润总额): accounting profit per the financial statements before income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a WFOE, use the statutory accounting basis. For a non-resident PE subject to deemed profit method, ignore this line and use the deemed profit ratio instead.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income (应纳税所得额): accounting profit adjusted for tax differences (e.g. non-deductible expenses, tax-exempt income, loss carryforwards).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident with a PE must compute taxable income from audited records; if records are unavailable, the competent tax authority will assess based on cost-plus deemed profit method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable (应纳所得税额): taxable income at 25% headline rate, reduced by lawful preferences and credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim preferential rates via attached schedules. A non-resident cannot claim small low-profit enterprise concession unless the PE is separately recognised as a territorial taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustment items: add-backs for non-deductible related-party payments, thin-capitalisation interest, and transfer pricing re-additions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document any cross-border royalty, interest, or management service payments; if a Taiwanese parent holds the medical-device intangible property, the WFOE must prove that royalty rates comply with arm's length standards.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000–10,000 per return; monthly penalty of 0.05% of unpaid tax due for continued default; additional penalty of 50% of underpaid tax for failure to report correct income, increasing to 100% for intentional concealment; criminal liability for fraudulent evasion exceeding RMB 50,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% of the gross dividend distributed by a PRC resident enterprise to a non-resident Taiwanese parent company without a permanent establishment in China.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Cross-Strait Tax Agreement (CSDTA) was signed in 2015; its treaty relief rules are not yet in force due to incomplete ratification procedures. Upon entry into force, the shareholder must obtain a Taiwan Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) and submit Form 007 (Information Report on Enjoyment of Tax Treaty Treatment) to the withholding agent before dividend distribution. The agent applies the treaty-reduced rate at source and retains the TRC and the beneficial ownership questionnaire. While the CSDTA is ineffective, the statutory 10% WHT applies and no unilateral refund is legally available.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 10% on gross royalty payments and 10% on interest payments to non-residents. Royalties additionally trigger 6% VAT (and 12% local surcharges on VAT) unless exempt. Under the CSDTA (upon force), royalty WHT would be limited to 3% and interest to 7%, but current enforceability is not recognised.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory if annual related-party tangible asset transactions reach RMB 200 million; intangible transactions RMB 100 million; financial transactions RMB 100 million; other related-party transactions RMB 40 million. Master File is required if aggregate related-party transaction value exceeds RMB 1 billion in the same tax year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not have a standalone Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) statute; however, the GAAR and substance-over-form principles under Article 47 of the Tax Collection Administration Law and the BEPS MLI require that a manufacturing WFOE maintain real economic presence in China (physical premises, qualified personnel, operational decision-making, and risk control functions). The Taiwan parent's control over technology and strategic manufacturing decisions must be supported by actual service agreements and cost allocations; otherwise tax authorities may disregard the Chinese entity's separate existence and re-characterise profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating taxable revenue from surgical laparoscopy tower sales through use of fictitious related-party purchase invoices from a Taiwan shell supplier and recording artificial COGS inflation to shift manufacturing profit offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Understated tax is subject to 100% penalty (Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law), daily late surcharge of 0.05% per day, criminal fine of up to five times the evaded tax, and imprisonment up to seven years for responsible personnel under PRC Criminal Law Article 201.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false tax returns may be held personally liable for restitution, face travel bans, asset freezing, and imprisonment if the evasion is egregious; the corporate veil may be pierced under PRC Company Law Article 20.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Chinese WFOE operates solely as a booking centre: no manufacturing assets, no technical staff, no physical premises, and no independent commercial rationale; all engineering and sales functions remain in Taiwan, while the Chinese entity records the global revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may recharacterise the entire taxable income under GAAR, disallow cost deductions, deem a dividend distribution, and levy 10% WHT on the recharacterised amount; civil fraud penalties may reach 300% of underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may become jointly liable for the company's tax debts under the alter-ego doctrine; travel restrictions and prohibition from departing Mainland China are commonly imposed; serious cases trigger criminal investigation for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large inbound TT wires from unrelated Taiwanese trading entities without performing customer due diligence, or routing round-trip funds into China as royalty payments to a Taiwan parent without commercial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Institution fines up to RMB 1 million per violation; freezing of bank accounts; suspension of VAT rebate qualification; revocation of foreign-exchange registration; referral to the Anti-Money Laundering Bureau for criminal prosecution under PRC Criminal Law Article 191.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives and AML compliance officers may face personal criminal fines and up to ten years' imprisonment for money laundering offences; civil liability for damages arising from undisclosed UBO structures.
